fact_text: The company's founder graduated from SM Commerce College in 1992 and started work at a motorcycle parts shop run by his uncle in Aurangzeb Market, later receiving a working share in that business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: After about ten years in his uncle's trade, the founder set up a separate parts shop and import business built on the principle that quality would be sold.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company offered a parts guarantee that also covered mechanic errors and dishonest customer claims, which the founder said required confidence in its own product quality before it could be given.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said a guarantee in Pakistan exposes a seller to fraud and false warranty claims, so a company giving one has to absorb cheating as well as genuine defects.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said many rivals copied the warranty promise without the product quality behind it, which damaged the guarantee's credibility in the parts market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said a brand represents a company's qualities and policies, not a name printed on a box, and that the company's early years were hard before customer trust built up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company said it has been in the Pakistani motorcycle parts market for more than 25 years, having started with imported parts and then built local vendors alongside its brand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company said about 95% of the parts in its 70cc and 125cc motorcycles are made locally, with imports under 10% of content, as of August 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said a Chinese 125cc-class bike cost about $300 in the early 2000s, which at roughly 60 rupees to the dollar came to about 18,000 rupees, the price gap that created the market opening.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company first sold completely built imported units, then became the complete knock-down kit supplier to much of the local motorcycle assembly industry, extending generous credit to assemblers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said credit extended to assemblers grew so large that the assemblers' own factories could not match it, which led the company to build its own motorcycle assembly plant with its customers as partners.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Around early 2025, Crown Group ended its partnership on its motorcycle assembly plant and handed the plant to its partner as it moved into electric bikes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company dropped its fuel motorcycle business to focus all investment on electric bikes, as stated in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: About 90% of the content of Crown Group's electric bike is imported, and the company's electric bike remains at a similar early import stage as its 2002 motorcycle localisation position.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management expects the imported share of its electric bike to fall below 50% within about two years, as frame, seat and other parts are localised quickly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company's electric bike programme is localising frame and seat parts, and the founder said the government's Engineering Development Board is working on the programme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company's new electric bike unit is being expanded beside its existing factory, which the video showed as work in progress.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Crown Group's Pakistani-road adaptation included replacing shock absorbers and making the frame heavier, because the speaker said local riders can weigh about 120 kg, while Chinese models were ridden by riders around 40 kg.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said the company's research and development centre is a long-term effort with engineers working on product development, rather than a quick import-and-sell model.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Crown Group's motorcycle parts business was reported to ship parts to Bangladesh and Afghanistan over 10-12 years, with Afghan shipments halted by conditions there and Bangladesh shipments continuing at lower volume.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said Crown Group is the only company selling parts in Bangladesh, a market he described as dominated by Indian motorcycle models.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company's export range is limited to common models such as the CG125, because it does not produce Indian-brand models like Bajaj or TVS, which the founder said do not fit its portfolio.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The 'Crown' name was given by the founder's maternal grandfather in 1963, when he imported parts, and the brand was later sold in Pakistan as Crown Lifan under a Lifan Group agreement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: After the Lifan Group agreement ended, the company renamed its brand as Crown Group, and the name is also used as an abbreviation for the company in its other businesses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Crown Group said it has built a scrap recycling loop in which scrap is remelted, aluminium is extracted, and the pure aluminium is turned into billet and then into motorcycle parts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The video described Pakistan's motorcycle after-sales network as about 75,000 mechanic workshops and 19,000 retailers reaching roughly 30 million motorcycle users, which the company called the biggest such network in the country.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management placed Crown Group next to Honda in after-sales service coverage, and said its target is to match Honda's position in electric bikes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company's electric bike makes four software systems in total: speedometer, controller, battery management and charger, all managed through a phone app for the customer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company is producing about 300 electric bikes a month, with a stated target of moving toward 10,000 bikes a month, from a motorcycle capacity of about 5,000 a month at the site.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said its target is 10,000 electric bikes a month.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Crown Group has about 2,300-2,400 employees across its complex, with about 150-200 working at the electric bike unit as of August 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Crown Group runs free training that converts long-serving motorcycle mechanics into EV technicians, and is signing agreements with universities to train EV mechanics.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder's younger son started a solar business in 2020, after the motorcycle business shrank during the COVID period and the company had to manage a large workforce with less work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The company's example put a motorcycle rider's petrol bill at about 15,000 rupees a month, falling to about 5,000 rupees on electricity, roughly one-third of the petrol cost even without solar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said that with solar charging an electric motorcycle's running cost could become free, and that instalment or lease payments can be covered from the fuel savings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Lead-acid motorcycle batteries take about 10 hours to charge and use six cells, while lithium-type batteries charge in about 3-4 hours, a difference the company used to justify its battery switch.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Crown Group's lithium-type battery is said to last about four years, with an 18-month warranty, and lets battery management be controlled through a phone app.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder argued that electric motorcycles need a full ecosystem of parts sourcing, localisation, service and recycling, which he said is harder to build than simply assembling imported parts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said EV service is harder than petrol service because batteries, chargers and controllers require specialist skills, and a punctured tyre on an electric bike cannot be fixed by an ordinary puncture shop.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said large groups entering the electric motorcycle market found the required after-sales service cost too high to manage, and some have already exited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said motorcycles wear far faster on Pakistani roads than cars, so service on a motorcycle fleet costs more and needs a dense network to be sustainable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said that Pakistan's 30 million motorcycles could all convert to electric over roughly the next 10-15 years, giving the company a long runway for its ecosystem.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said Crown Group holds a grip on the parts market and claims to have parts on almost every motorcycle on Pakistan's roads, which he presented as evidence of its market knowledge.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said the company's bikes compete on price and quality and are the best value in their category, a claim the video did not test against independent data.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said women workers at its plant tend to be more careful, less prone to theft and lower in cost than men, and that the factory was built to keep women workers safe.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said Pakistani households on lower incomes can afford solar and electric motorcycles because the savings are large, and that the shift also saves foreign exchange for the country.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder argued that money moved from manufacturing into real estate, leaving industrialisation weak, and that the twin results are joblessness and a foreign exchange shortage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said many Pakistani business owners put their money into property because it is the visible route to easy profit, which he argued has hollowed out manufacturing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder contrasted Pakistani industrial investors with Chinese manufacturers, saying the latter reinvest manufacturing profits, while Pakistani investors often use industrial plots only to park money.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said the company's own electric bike has been designed in-house, with the R&D centre developing product, unlike rivals that he said assemble bikes from Chinese components.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said Japanese motorcycles were far more expensive than Chinese ones in the early period, so buyers who could not afford Japanese bikes had to accept lower-quality Chinese parts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said the electric bike buyer would be convinced of the savings within about a year of use, and that instalment or lease payments can be covered by those savings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Crown Group is converting mechanics who have worked for 20-25 years into EV technicians, which the company said is a free training programme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said the company aims to keep customers satisfied in every case and avoids product lines that create constant customer complaints.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said motorcycle assembly still needs manual labour, and the company's own workers are engaged directly in the assembly work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said electric bikes can be damaged by wrong charging methods or water exposure, which causes short circuits, so customers need training on usage and charging.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said lead-acid batteries lack technical stability, and that the switch to lithium-type batteries was a bold step that is difficult to carry out.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: The founder said goods and services that are not produced domestically add nothing to GDP, so weak manufacturing leaves the economy with both joblessness and a foreign exchange shortage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)

fact_text: Management said many of its women workers come from nearby rural households, where the family gains when both spouses earn an income.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Crown Group’s EV Revolution Begins | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-17)
